scope: Only the 60 saved local Connect Four games; no external benchmark scores.
analysis: Post hoc descriptive analysis; tactical metrics were not prespecified tournament ranking criteria.

tactical_definitions.immediate_win: A gravity-legal placement completing four of the moving player; success chooses any such column.
tactical_definitions.blockable_threat: No immediate own win, at least one opponent immediate winning column before the move, and at least one legal own move leaving zero opponent immediate wins; success chooses such a move.
tactical_definitions.created_avoidable_immediate_threat: Neither player has an immediate win before the move, a safe own move exists, but chosen move leaves an opponent immediate win.
tactical_definitions.unit: A model decision occurrence; repeated positions count repeatedly and exposure differs across models.

timing_limitations: Harness times use the same request/response boundary for all models, including IPC, validation and any startup/loading wait.
Models use different backends; games have different positions, were run in stages, and no controlled latency benchmark was prespecified.
Native timers have different boundaries: Kev excludes encoding, Dev includes answer encoding, Von includes evaluation, Laya includes extra truncation checks.
Do not compare native timer values as like-for-like model speed or confuse either timing with video pacing.
uncertainty: Fixed openings and deterministic choices produce repeated states; no confidence intervals or global ranking claims are justified by these counts alone.
